messages:
Amelia: Ok team — we need a tight, customer-facing checklist for the upcoming pilot with Vaultly. Goal: clear go/no-go criteria for the pilot handoff + oncall runbook triggers. Can we consolidate?
Devin: Drafting now. Proposal: must meet perf & quality for 48h under pilot traffic. Perf: P95 < 180ms, P99 < 450ms, <=0.5% 5xx. Error budget burn <= 5% over 24h.
Sandeep: Add an edge-case for long context sessions — if median latency spikes only for >2048 tokens we should accept but document mitigation. Also flag embedding-fallback regression if embedding similarity drops >8% vs baseline.
Liz: For rollout gating: require canary for 6 hours at 10% traffic, then 60% for 2 hours with automated rollback on any of these: P99 > 600ms, 5xx > 1%, quality alert triggered.
Marco: Where does the oncall handoff live? We need explicit pager triggers and runbook link in the PRD. Also clarify who owns fast rollback vs config rollback.
Amelia: Good. Let's capture runbook triggers here and in the PRD checklist. I want a minimal set we can show the customer: perf, error budget, quality checks, and an ops action matrix.
Devin: Paste of checklist draft: ```
- 48h pilot pass window
- Perf: P95 < 180ms, P99 < 450ms
- Error budget: <=5% burn in 24h
- Quality: automated evals on 50 curated prompts, pass rate >= 92%
- Canary rollout: 10% 6h -> 60% 2h -> full
- Rollback triggers: P99 > 600ms, 5xx > 1%, eval regression > 3 points
- Oncall triggers: incident page open + notify eng-oncall
```
Sandeep: That evals line — define "pass rate" precisely. Is it top-1 exact match? Fuzzy score? We need metric + test harness.
Liz: Also add customer-impact classification: Sev1 (complete blocking for >5% requests), Sev2 (degraded results >15% of queries), Sev3 (minor). That maps to escalation times.
Marco: I'll add ownership rows: Core infra owns rollback plan & cross-region failover. Product owns quality evaluation and customer comms. Eng-oncall handles immediate rollback if trigger fires.
deploy-bot: deployment status: canary started at 2245001180 by @devops (10% traffic). CI: green.
Amelia: Great — next steps: Devin incorporate Sandeep's eval definition + Liz's severity mapping. Marco add ownership to PRD checklist. I'll sync with Vaultly PM Tue 10am. If we have this doc by EOD Monday we can start canary Wed.
slo-bot: Alert rule suggestion: add a rolling-5m P99 alert with 10m auto-snooze on infra noise and require manual ack for repeated fires.
Devin: Noted — I'll formalize alert thresholds and add runbook links. Will post updated checklist here when done.
Sandeep: Also, add a short section for edge-case recovery: 1) KV cache reset procedure, 2) quantization fallback toggles, 3) embedding-service fallback to smaller model.
Amelia: Thanks team — please aim for the checklist + runbook PR by EOD. If anyone can't, shout now.
Liz: I'm good to take the severity mapping + escalation times.
Marco: I'll own the PRD checklist commit and ping security for the customer-specific config review.
Devin: Working on it, will post diff in thread by 2245001300.
Amelia: Perfect. Closing loop: we'll use this as the canonical pilot acceptance artifact for Vaultly and future pilots. :slightly_smiling_face:
